comment: What a volume calls outside itself. DirtySource is a memory region's sealed checkpoint (vmmemory.MemoryRegionCheckpoint), whose pages may be spilled to the host's disk; the simulated VMM hands each capture the pager's own with its errors returned at random (sealedPages in internal/simtest/guest.go). JournalCover and Replayer are the host's durable flush (host/journal.go, host/replay.go), over the membership and the peers that serve journal disks. See scripts/check-faults.py.

faults.none: the set the seal froze, held in this process

faults.purpose: a sealed page the pager spilled could not be read: the publication fails and gives the pages back, and the next checkpoint takes them; a fork child's read through the point fails and is asked again
the capture fails behind the pause, and the host's release unseals the guest

faults.none: a duration the seal holds in this process
marks the seal in this process

faults.purpose: a fork point could not lend its pages to a child on its own host: the receive fails and the child is discarded
the seal stays although its checkpoint landed: a fork's root still gives its parent's point back, and the next capture's release ends the seal
the wait for the journal to place the pause ended with the publication: the selection fails and the flushes it would have answered wait for the next checkpoint

faults.none: trims the journal in this process and returns nothing; a trim it could not make is made by the next selection or the host's trim

faults.purpose: a lost host's journal disk the cloud has not attached to a survivor is served by no member: the open takes no epoch and is asked again
the open cannot tell who serves the journals and is refused before it takes an epoch
the member serving the journal could not be read: nothing read is applied, and the open is asked again
the replay cannot find the journals' holders: nothing is applied and the open fails
a journal formatted again lost the flushes it held: the open is refused with ErrJournalLost and only an operator's discard opens the VM
faults.deferred: TASK-117: no campaign formats a journal disk again, and none has an oracle for the flushes such a disk loses

faults.error: the journal disk's read fails or finds a damaged entry
faults.purpose: a recovery writes none of a damaged entry's bytes into the VM and reports it
faults.deferred: TASK-104.20: nothing fails a read of a journal disk or damages an entry it synced yet
